extractedSignals: Through this LinkedIn MCP server, AI assistants like Claude can connect to your LinkedIn.
Access profiles and companies, search for jobs, or get job details.
This tool controls a real browser session; it doesn't exploit undocumented APIs or bypass authentication.
That said, LinkedIn's TOS prohibit automated tools.
So far, no users have been banned for using this MCP.
What if my agents execute too many actions?
LinkedIn may send you a warning about automated tool usage.
If that happens, reduce your automation volume.
